lenses.assessment: SceneBuildingId and furniture identity become raw u64 at a shared visual-seed helper. Relate exact current seam to rig producer F004 and owner F004, which distinguish identity from shared Seed; preserve framing.

SceneBuildingId, OpeningAssemblyId, Seed, StreamId and BuildingAppearance own distinct purposes. Convert source identity deliberately at the visual seed boundary; do not force furniture IDs into a building identity.

The inspected tactical placement-slice validator rejects zero/duplicate IDs, but not every possible ECS construction or delayed publication. StreamId constructor rejects an empty purpose; complete RNG and external rendering validation not inspected.

Appearance table is constructed in enum order and current bins cover the match. Native range updates depend on cached membership changes; no arithmetic or scheduling failure claimed without supported route.
Building/opening IDs, facade set, bool, range and scene entity lifecycle must agree. Same-ID/opening lookup and scene cleanup are partial evidence; other spawn/removal/order remain open q585.

A shared deterministic visual sampling function can use Seed while original building and furniture identity remain separate; old rig owner versus producer wording needs central reconciliation rather than a building-only abstraction.
The facade bool caches derived set membership and triggers range changes; that is not a second gameplay authority by itself. A stale cache needs a supported lifecycle or external range writer proof.

Role2511 is byte-identical; role2512 diff changes test-only setup and test names. This does not prove behavior, generated texture content or a passing test; future migration must preserve stream framing, palette and LOD contracts.
Appearance and LOD levels are named enums; facade bool is a local cached predicate for range updates. No enum coercion finding without an invalid neighboring payload or lifecycle witness.
Source uses derives on components/enums and no handwritten serialization in assigned bodies; no independent derivability finding. The native VisibilityRange adapter remains an external interface.

Scene-building identity, opening identity and deterministic Seed are different roles; color palette, PBR maps, scalar factors and visual LOD stages cannot be collapsed just because values share primitive types.

The static visual.building.appearance literal is the named StreamId purpose and existing contract; preserve its framing rather than replace it as incidental UI text. Test names are source-only diagnostics.

Distribution thresholds, authored palette bytes, tile scale, LOD ranges and native channel factors have distinct policy meaning. Preserve current values and units while tracing owner/consumer; do not classify constants alone as defects.
